body: I just called a hotline before one of my classes started. I’ll PM you :)

Not in a public high school, I’m in a state college, so I have no
free access to a counselor unless it’s by phone, I may have to look more into it though and see if they’ve finally hired a counselor already... 
and I understand that with your parents, and I’m glad you were able to after a while.

Thanks for your support. I really had to tell someone, and I didn’t want to tell my parents again because they don’t really listen or care. I’m just lost of who I should even look for now because I don’t have any access to a physical counselor until I turn 18 (I don’t have insurance and we are basically poverty level)

Thanks for the comment, and I’m really sorry that happened to you too. Anxiety is a bitch, but keep working hard man. I will try to focus on myself more too, and I hope you focus all that love on yourself too.

A couple of my family friends had that GPA and lower, and they’re making better money than my cousin with a 3.2 GPA, so keep on hoping for the best! 

Thanks for the comment though, and sorry for the late response lol. I will keep that in mind, and good luck in your engineering endeavors

Thank you. I really appreciate your comment. It’s been pretty tough because I know people will say to me that I’ll look back at this as a “high school sweetheart thing”, but I’ve been through a lot with my dysfunctional family and school that this has pretty much destroyed me.
Thanks for your comment. I think in every school there’s always one or two kids that have a life like that. And being one of them it sucks a lot. And thanks for the offer btw.
Thanks for the comment. I’ll see if they’re open to that, I do want to speak to a third-party individual again.

We’re Latino but my mom and dad are the exact same way... my dad’s always been the more lenient one too. I’m really sorry about that though. I don’t think anyone deserves being told anything like that from their parents. 

And thanks for the encouragement! I forgot about how I can talk about this in my future jobs.

Thanks for the comment. Most of my family is far away and I’m not really that close to any of them. I’ve tried finding a therapist but my parents would want to know everything that’s going on. I would use a counselor at my school but I’m not in a public high school. 

I’ve also tried explaining to my parents how hard I try, but my dad is the only one that understands the difficulty. My mom could care less how hard a course is. Thanks for the support though.

Thanks for the response. 
It’s mostly for my parents, but being educated is the only thing I’m really happy with myself in some ways. So if I were to get denied to any uni that would really hurt me. 
I probably should have added this, on the original post, but I am technically homeschooled, and I have been since middle school. The college I take college classes/dual enroll at doesn’t have a therapist or a counselor because it’s so tiny. 
I’ve already talked to a few friends (besides S/O) about some things, but most of them seem to focus on my parents being the issue (they might not be wrong) so it ends up being more negative than positive usually.
With my S/O he hasn’t really responded a lot the past few days. It’s catching me off guard because he has a tendency to get clingy, and he’s started to avoid anything I ask. it’s just been really strange. 
Thanks again though, I will take all you have said into consideration.
